items.title: 初次见面
items.text: 我的名字是阿斯托洛吉斯 · 莫娜 · 梅姬斯图斯，意为「伟大的占星术士莫娜」。如果想找我占卜，记住我的名字是最基本的尊重…而且要一次性全念对！
items.text_en: I am Astrologist Mona Megistus, meaning "The Great Astrologist Mona." If it is divination you seek from me, then I ask you respect my name by learning it wholly, here and now.

items.title: 闲聊·占卜
items.text: 占卜就是把既定的命运准确地展示出来。过度的修饰，只会让人们产生误解。
items.text_en: Divination is about precisely foretelling one's written destiny. Over-embellishing that fate only leads to misconception.

items.title: 闲聊·生活
items.text: 限制物欲是占星术士修行的一部分，只有简朴地生活，才能窥探到世界的真实。
items.text_en: Astrologers must rid themselves of material desires. Only by ridding oneself of clutter can one see the true world around them.

items.title: 闲聊·命运
items.text: 正是因为无法更改，无可违逆，只能接受，命运才会被称之为命运。
items.text_en: Fate is called as such, for it cannot be changed, nor can it be reversed. It can only but be accepted.

items.title: 下雨的时候
items.text: 这么大的雨…不仅看不见星光，连水占盘都模糊了。
items.text_en: With rain this heavy, not only are the stars clouded, so too is my scryglass hazy.

items.title: 打雷的时候
items.text: 这些落雷…究竟是从哪个星空降下的呢？
items.text_en: Which of the starry skies do these thunderbolts fall from?

items.title: 下雪的时候
items.text: 纯净的融雪之水，很适合用在水占盘里。
items.text_en: The pure waters of melted snow are optimal for hydromancy.

items.title: 阳光很好
items.text: 嗯，是个无须占卜也能感觉到的好天气。
items.text_en: One need not scry to know today's weather will be good.

items.title: 早上好
items.text: 你来得不巧，清晨的启明星刚刚消失了…早餐？我，我已经吃过了。
items.text_en: Your arrival is untimely. The morning star has just waned... Breakfast? No, I—I've already eaten.

items.title: 中午好
items.text: 已经正午了，去吃点东西吧，嗯？我…我吃份沙拉就行了，呃…简朴的生活是…是占星术士修行的一环！
items.text_en: Noon is upon us, we should eat. Hm? I... I will have a salad, for simplicity is the way of the astrologer.

items.title: 晚上好
items.text: 入夜了，过会就可以开始占卜…呃，昨天的稿子我写了没…
items.text_en: Nightfall has arrived. I will soon be able to begin my divination. Ah... Did I finish writing my astrology column last night...?

items.title: 晚安
items.text: 已经这么晚了，明天截稿的稿子一点没动…什么？你要去休息了？呜…我也想去睡觉…
items.text_en: It's already so late, and I'm no further along on finishing tomorrow's astrology column. What? You're off to sleep? *sigh* I wish I could sleep now too...

items.title: 关于莫娜自己
items.text: 占星术士的工作，是向人们明确地展示他们即将面对的命运，我也是这么做的…不过，总有些人不愿意接受。
items.text_en: The work of the astrologer is to show people what fate has in store for them, and that's exactly what I do. There will always be those, however, who are unable to accept what they are told.

items.title: 关于我们·工作
items.text: 为什么要写稿，不用占卜来赚钱？…我才不会为摩拉而使用「水占术」…我也不是因为这个而学习「水占术」的。
items.text_en: Why do I write reports rather than using my divination to earn Mora? I would never use hydromancy for the sake of Mora, nor did I learn hydromancy for that purpose.

items.title: 关于我们·我的命运
items.text: 我不知道。除非万不得已，占星术士不会占卜自己的命运。老太婆以前说过，这种行为可能会导致命运的自相矛盾，很危险。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6I don't know. Unless left with no other choice, astrologers do not foretell their own fate. The elders of my art warned against it, for it can turn fate in on itself, which is incredibly dangerous.

items.title: 关于我们· 你的命运
items.text: 你不是这个世界的人，所以我无法准确地为你预言。我只能告诉你，你要走的路还远未到尽头。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6As you are not from this world, I am unable to give you a prediction. All I can tell you is that your journey is far from over.

items.title: 关于「神之眼」·嫌弃
items.text: 我刚刚拿到「神之眼」的时候，那个老太婆还假模假样地说什么「愿你求真之心永在」。结果这东西在「水占术」上一点用场都派不上，只会糊我一身水…
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 3When I first received my Vision, the elderly woman that gave it to me, she put on this air and said "May your heart of truth be with you." And yet this thing does nothing for my hydromancy, all it does is get me wet.

items.title: 关于「神之眼」·价值
items.text: 哎…不过，「神之眼」当成个小饰品，装在身上倒是无所谓。毕竟，这也算那个抠门老太婆破天荒送我的「教具」。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 5That said, a Vision doesn't hurt to have as a little accessory. It is, after all, the one useful study tool that miserly old lady ever gave me, in a rare act of generosity.

items.title: 有什么想要分享
items.text: 你听说过「命之座」吗？占星术士认为，「命之座」是「神之眼」持有者的命运在星空上的映射，过去，现在和未来，所有的一切都在其中昭示。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6Do you know about constellations? Astrologers believe that the patterns of the stars map out the destinies of Vision bearers — past, present, and future, everything is written in the stars.

items.title: 感兴趣的见闻
items.text: 欸——你身边带着的这个小家伙，到底来自哪里？无论我用什么方法，都没法找到一丝关于她命运的踪迹。…哈？你也不知道？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4This... travel companion of yours — do you know anything of her origins? No matter what, I cannot seem to discern a single shred of information regarding this floating fairy's fate. ...Oh? So you don't know where she comes from, either?

items.title: 关于琴
items.text: 那位西风骑士团代理团长？她的「命之座」是「幼狮座」，象征着力量，还有过早担负的责任。「雄狮」早早离群，但她会继续成长，直到能完全继承狮群的荣耀。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4You mean the Acting Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius? Her constellation is Leo Minor, which represents strength and responsibility shouldered too young... Though the lioness has been separated from her pride for a long time, she grows from strength to strength, and the day will come when she is ready to return as its glorious leader.

items.title: 关于阿贝多
items.text: 阿贝多？啊…我真羡慕他，只用专注于研究就好，不用管其他的杂事，真是美好的生活啊。如果那个老太婆脑筋正常一点，我应该也过着这种生活吧…
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Albedo? Ah... I envy his ability to solely focus on his research without getting bogged down in mundane worldly affairs. What a wonderful life! If that batty old lady hadn't had one too many screws loose, perhaps that's the life I'd be living by now myself...

items.title: 关于可莉
items.text: 你是说，艾莉丝的女儿啊。她住在西风骑士团，还有阿贝多照顾…怎么说呢，哎…她的「命之座」不愧是象征着幸运的「四叶草」啊，真羡慕…啊不过，要是我也有这么好的运气，首先就不会遇见那个老太婆了。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Ah yes, Alice's daughter. She's in the custody of the Knights of Favonius, and Albedo looks after her too. She's blessed to have Trifolium as her constellation, which represents good luck. I'm slightly envious... *smirk* Although, if I'd been blessed with good luck, I suppose I never would have had the great honor of running into that old woman, would I...

items.title: 关于迪卢克
items.text: 迪卢克·莱艮芬德。「夜枭」是他的「命之座」，象征着黑夜中的警觉，和孤独的守望。在他所认可的白昼来临之前，他都将孤独前行。等等，「夜枭」象不象征财富来着？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Diluc Ragnvindr. His constellation, Noctua, represents vigilance in the darkness of night... A lone guardian keeping watch, longing for the splendor of dawn, yet destined to solitude in the dark days preceding its arrival....Or, wait, maybe Noctua's the one tied to wealth...?

items.title: 关于凯亚
items.text: 凯亚·亚尔伯里奇吗？他的「孔雀羽座」象征着高贵，但同时也象征着「华丽的掩饰」。他以为已经和过去一刀两断。但到了命中注定的那天，他依然必须做出自己的选择。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Kaeya Alberich? He's a Pavo Ocellus. Destined for greatness and grandeur... and to hide ugly realities behind a layer of charm and elegance. He believes he has made a clean break with his past, but one day fate will catch up with him. When it does, he will have a major decision to make.

items.title: 关于丽莎
items.text: 她的「命之座」以「沙漏」为名，象征着知识、时间与等价交换。一粒沙子落下，时间…或者说生命，就消逝一刹。如果想要止住沙粒奔流，只能平放沙漏，让它永不流动。嗨…简单来说，就是变着法偷懒啦。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4A Tempus Fugit... The constellation derives its name from the hourglass, and stands for knowledge and time — or rather, the trade-off between them. As each grain of sand falls down, a moment of time — of life, even, dies for good. To stop the unrelenting flow of sand, one would have to turn the hourglass on its side. But once the sand comes to rest, it remains motionless forever... Hmm, maybe 'becomes lazy' is more accurate than 'comes to rest,' in this case.

items.title: 关于温迪
items.text: 温迪？那个成天无所事事的吟游诗人？咦，他有什么有趣的吗？我占卜看看…咦，水占盘怎么…什么也看不清，怎，怎么起风了，眼睛都睁不开了！我的帽子！衣服，衣服要被吹跑了！停下来！我不干了！我不干了！
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Venti? The bard that sits around doing nothing all day? What's so interesting about him? Sure, I guess I can take a look... Huh, that's weird, the scryglass, it's... I can't see a thing... this wind... I can't... open my eyes! No, my hat! Ah! My clothes, stop! The wind's going to strip all my clothes off! Make it stop, make it stop! ...Alright, alright! I'll never do this again!

items.title: 想要了解莫娜·其一
items.text: 你的意思是…想要闲聊？唔，我很少做这种浪费时间的事，而且稿子还有很多没写…嗯，不过，对象是你的话，也不是不行。呵呵，就当是换个心情吧。
items.text_en: You want to chat... for fun? Oh... I don't usually have spare time for such activities, especially when I have so many columns left to write... Then again, since it's you, it might be worth it. Hehe, a change of pace once in a while isn't such a bad thing.

items.title: 想要了解莫娜·其二
items.text: 占卜的收入…？不要用钱财这种…「东西」来衡量占星术！你听好了，我的「水占术」可是这片提瓦特大陆上，唯一能窥探到真实命运的占卜术！无论是摩拉还是宝石，都无法用来称量「命运」！所以，不要再问这种蠢问题了！
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 3Income? From astrology...? You can't use... things like Mora to determine the value of astrology! You need to understand: hydromancy is the one and only means of discerning people's true destiny in the whole of Teyvat! No matter how much Mora or gems you might have, the value of fate is quite simply incalculable! Perhaps not the smartest question you might have had for me...

items.title: 想要了解莫娜·其三
items.text: 我的占卜术？说了你也不明白，哼，不过…给你解释一下也不是不行。我使用的是「水占术」。是基由星空映射在水面上的幻象进行推演的占卜术，以水中幻相倒映虚假之天，以此来窥探着世界的真实。这是那个老太婆唯一一个正经的研究成果。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4You want me to explain how astrology works? I'm not sure you'd understand even if I told you. But since you ask... The method I use is called hydromancy. The art of inferring fate from the illusory reflection of the stars on the water's surface. The inverted reflection in the water is an image of the heavens from within which the truth of our world can be observed. ...It is the one and only success story of that old lady's research endeavors.

items.title: 想要了解莫娜·其四
items.text: 阿斯托洛吉斯·莫娜·梅姬斯图斯。这是那个老太婆之前和我一起定的名字，她说这名字的拼写里有一些她很喜欢的要素。哼，不过她有时会叫我「梅姬」，和常用的「莫娜」不一样，更像是小名…喂！你不能这么叫！很害羞的！早知道…早知道就不告诉你了！
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 5Mona Megistus, the Astrologist — we came up with that name together, the old lady and me. She said it had a nice ring to it... But then she started calling me 'Meg' for short, which I hate, because obviously 'Mona' is already sufficient for a shorter name— No! You are NOT allowed to call me that, it's embarrassing! Gah! I knew I shouldn't have told you!

items.title: 想要了解莫娜·其五
items.text: 占卜师有一个禁忌：在占卜时只陈述预言，绝不提出任何建议。以免自己也陷入别人的「命运」之中。但如果占卜对象是你，那这个「禁忌」就无所谓了。因为，我们的「命运」早就交织在一起了。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6The golden rule all fortune-tellers abide by is: never offer advice. Only state the results of the divination. Otherwise, you risk your fate becoming tangled up with that of your subject. But for you, I will make an exception to this rule — because our fates have been intertwined from the beginning.

items.title: 莫娜的爱好
items.text: 我的爱好？仰望星空。在这个真实得太过分的世界里，每个人都需要仰望星空，更何况，我还是个占星术士。
items.text_en: My hobby? Stargazing! In this all-too-real world in which we live, we all need to look up from the dust once in a while and fix our gaze on the stars, in a spirit of wonder... That, plus the whole thing about me being an astrologer.

items.title: 莫娜的烦恼
items.text: 仪器修缮费，预订的星象仪要补款了，学术杂志的订购钱也没交，还有下个月的房租…到底先交哪个比较好。果然还是…先把星象仪的尾款补了，不然被抢购光了就糟糕了…
items.text_en: *sigh* The equipment repair bill is due, and so is the final payment for that celestial globe I ordered... Also, I still need to renew my journal subscriptions, not to mention pay the rent... Hmm, which one to prioritize? ...Ah, I'll pay off the celestial globe first. If I leave it any longer, they'll sell out, and then I'll never get my hands on one...

items.title: 喜欢的食物
items.text: 沙拉，沙拉是天底下最棒的食物。原料便宜，容易做，饱肚子。而且吃起来很方便，在写稿或者修理仪器的时候，可以很快吃掉。
items.text_en: Salad. Salad is by far the best food in the world. Cheap to buy, easy to whip up, filling, and it's the most convenient thing there is when you're working on a column or fixing some equipment — I mean, who's got time for a proper dinner anyway?

items.title: 讨厌的食物
items.text: 各种…价钱很昂贵，吃起来又很麻烦的食物。因为，呃…用摩拉去满足不必要的食欲，是低俗又危险的。
items.text_en: You know, all those... overpriced, fancy foods. Personally, I think it's uncivilized and, frankly, dangerous to splash out and indulge yourself every time you have a little hunger pang.

items.title: 收到赠礼·其一
items.text: 啊，好满足——没想到，认识你还是挺不错的嘛。
items.text_en: Ah, so satisfied... Who would have thought knowing you would bear so many benefits.

items.title: 收到赠礼·其二
items.text: 我再确认一下。真的是…你请客吗？
items.text_en: Just to be clear... you're sure I don't have to pay... for any of this?

items.title: 收到赠礼·其三
items.text: 我没有什么想挑剔的。就是…唔…没怎么吃饱。
items.text_en: I don't mean to nitpick, or anything, it's just... I haven't quite eaten enough.

items.title: 生日
items.text: 生日快乐。这个袋子给你，里面有一个帮你渡过难关的「建议」。别着急打开，在往后的一年之内，这个袋子会有自己打开的机会。
items.text_en: Happy Birthday. Here's my gift to you — it's a bag containing some words of advice that may help you through tough patches. ...No, don't open it yet. During the year ahead, this bag will open itself when the right time comes.

items.title: 突破的感受·起
items.text: 命中当如此，我早已预知到了。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 1This was ordained by fate! Long had I foreseen it.

items.title: 突破的感受·承
items.text: …再进一步，就能找到世界的真实了吗？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 2...One step closer. Maybe soon I shall finally uncover the truth of this world?

items.title: 突破的感受·转
items.text: 虚假之天，星空下的命运早已注定。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 4My scryglass has long since preordained all that will take place beneath the stars it reflects.

items.title: 突破的感受·合
items.text: 水中之影，涟漪中窥见启明星升起。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 6In the reflection of the water, I see the ascension of the morning star.

items.title: 元素战技·其一
items.text: 水中幻愿。
items.text_en: Let me scry!

items.title: 元素战技·其二
items.text: …命运的虚影。
items.text_en: Shadows of fate!

items.title: 元素战技·其三
items.text: 命运，倒映水中。
items.text_en: Delve into destiny!

items.title: 元素爆发·其一
items.text: 命运，在此显现。
items.text_en: Fate is upon you.

items.title: 元素爆发·其二
items.text: 命定于此。
items.text_en: Written in the stars!

items.title: 元素爆发·其三
items.text: 天命既定！
items.text_en: Decided by destiny!

items.title: 打开风之翼·其一
items.text: 这样更能看清星空了…
items.text_en: Scry the sky!

items.title: 打开宝箱·其一
items.text: 希望这种好事能多来几次…
items.text_en: We could do with some more fortune...

items.title: 打开宝箱·其二
items.text: 房租和伙食费，都有着落了！
items.text_en: This should cover food and rent for a while!

items.title: 打开宝箱·其三
items.text: 呜…找到宝物的感觉真棒啊…
items.text_en: Ah, finding treasure is pretty exhilarating!

items.title: 生命值低·其一
items.text: 无法判断…
items.text_en: My vision is clouded...

items.title: 生命值低·其二
items.text: 讨厌的命运…
items.text_en: Odius fate...

items.title: 生命值低·其三
items.text: 还没…推算到这！
items.text_en: This was not foretold!

items.title: 同伴生命值低·其一
items.text: 再硬撑，你就会倒下咯。
items.text_en: Do not tempt fate.

items.title: 同伴生命值低·其二
items.text: 你还没到命运的终点。
items.text_en: This is not your destiny.

items.title: 倒下·其一
items.text: 星空…黯淡…
items.text_en: The stars... are fading...

items.title: 倒下·其二
items.text: 无法违抗的…命运…
items.text_en: Destiny cannot be... denied.

items.title: 倒下·其三
items.text: 推算结束了…
items.text_en: My reckoning... has come...

items.title: 普通受击·其一
items.text: 烦人。
items.text_en: Curses.

items.title: 重受击·其一
items.text: 离我…远点！
items.text_en: Leave my space!

items.title: 加入队伍·其一
items.text: 此乃，命运。
items.text_en: This is destiny.

items.title: 加入队伍·其二
items.text: 真没办法。
items.text_en: This is how it must be.

items.title: 加入队伍·其三
items.text: 繁星，尽在掌握。
items.text_en: It is as the stars foretold.
